title: Ex-offenders Hired under Jobs Growth Incentive
what_it_is: Ex-offenders Hired under Jobs Growth Incentive

sections.label: Jobs Growth Incentive ex-offender hires
sections.summary: The Jobs Growth Incentive supported over 270,000 local hires and about 780 ex-offender hires from September 2020 to February 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Based on the latest available data, the Jobs Growth Incentive (JGI) has supported the hiring of more than 270,000 locals from September 2020 to February 2021 by 42,000 employers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Employers who have hired ex-offenders through the Yellow Ribbon Singapore (YRSG), Industrial and Services Co-operative Society (ISCOS), or halfway houses engaged by the Singapore Prison Service will automatically receive the JGI of up to $54,000 for these hires.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The JGI has supported around 780 ex-offender hires between September 2020 and February 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Environmental Services, Food Services, Logistics, Wholesale Trade and Construction were among the top five hiring sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: They collectively accounted for almost eight in 10 of JGI-supported ex-offenders.

sections.label: Yellow Ribbon Singapore ex-offender job placements
sections.summary: From September 2020 to February 2021, YRSG assisted over a third of released ex-offenders, placing 96% in jobs, with 56% JGI-eligible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: From the period from September 2020 to February 2021, the YRSG has assisted more than a third of the ex-offenders who have been released from Prison, out of which 96% of those assisted by YRSG have been placed in a job.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Out of this number, 56% were eligible for JGI.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The balance of about 40% of these ex-offenders who were placed in jobs but were not eligible for JGI was because the employers themselves did not meet the requirement of having increased their local headcount compared to the August 2020 baseline.
